title: Texture & material randomization (randomize_textures_all)
desc: One roll does all of this at once. Surfaces with a texture — floor, backdrop wall and cup body — get a random photo from a 200-image DTD subset (real messy surfaces, full hue range incl. warm; dr_texture_paths). Flat-colored surfaces (boards, cup) get rgba ±0.15 plus specular/shininess/reflectance jitter around authored values. Cubes are categorical: each independently green OR yellow per episode, gloss still jittering. Same seed-5 layout in every tile. Off by default for PiPER-X cubes-in-cup.
metrics: 10 eligible visual geoms · 7 rolls: 4-7 materials re-colored per roll, 21 photo swaps (pool = 200 DTD images) · cubes categorical green|yellow
